title: Prove the owned-exit cut bound for P104 natives: ≥|W| owned exits per port-clique cut, tight on #6833's native, ruling out one-unit owned shortenings (no κ)
body:
No κ claim. This adds `research/p104-owned-exit-cut-bound/`, a registered research package for the card `p104-side-correction`.

**Claim.** For any native word obeying the frame law (public MOVEs strictly ascend; ADD, COPY and SCALE at a common frame; COPY only into a zeroed owned register; no owned register left at exit; owned MOVEs in any direction; dirty CLEAR, helpers and singular endpoint maps allowed), and any vector set `Q`, the number of owned MOVE events from a frame meeting `Q` to a frame missing `Q` is at least `rank T[final publics outside U_Q, initial publics inside U_Q]`. For a port clique `W` (`q.q' = 1` for all ports in `W`) and `W <= Q <= A(W)` this rank is `|W|`. The proof is a forward row-operation argument: the outside-rows matrix changes only by elementary row operations, deletions, and one new row per owned exit.

**Application.** On the native word of #6833 (9|9 chain-nested root) the bound is tight on all 1967 maximal port cliques (owned exits = `|W|`). Every one-unit end shortening of each owned lifetime is infeasible, each with a stored `(W,Q)` certificate: 246 core replacement frames and 547 ascending-start variants.

**Controls.** 31,000 exact random legal words (owned moves in both directions, dirty CLEARs, singular maps): 0 violations. Control with public MOVEs allowed to descend: 65,551 violations.

**Scope.** A necessary condition in the abstract legal model; it bounds owned MOVE events, not dimension mass (the word is tight at 8 events), and a certificate shows only that the stated owned-move multiset is infeasible. It does not cover edits that change several lifetimes, add moves or change the root. No word is constructed and nothing is priced.

**How to verify.** `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned-exit-cut-bound/check.py` (standard library only, about two minutes, reads only the two data files in the package) ends with `PASS_P104_OWNED_EXIT_CUT_BOUND`; `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-owned-exit-cut-bound` prints `PASS_REGISTERED`.
